questions.stem: A person has a disease that destroys the villi in their small intestine. What effect would this have?

options.text: They would absorb fewer nutrients, leading to weight loss and malnutrition
They would need to eat less food
They would produce more digestive enzymes
They would digest food more slowly

questions.explanation: Damaged villi means a reduced surface area for absorption. Fewer nutrients would be absorbed into the blood, leading to malnutrition and weight loss despite eating normally.
